extraction.title: FEATURE: Localization fallbacks (server-side)
extraction.head: localization-system-post

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding a server-side i18n fallback chain (user locale, then site default, then English) through a FallbackLocaleList in config/initializers/i18n.rb. It adds I18n.ensure_loaded! in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb, called from ApplicationController#set_locale. It also consolidates pluralization.rb into the i18n initializer and removes config.i18n.fallbacks = true from the environment files. Confidence score 3/5, citing thread-safety concerns with @loaded_locales ||= [] and asking that pluralization be verified as not dropped.

"logic: Race condition: `@loaded_locales ||= []` is not thread-safe." Notes that if two threads call ensure_loaded! before @loaded_locales is initialized, both could initialize it, causing inconsistencies.
